_what: What each place a message is written to can show, as one capability record per surface (src/surface-compose.mjs). `html` whether markup inside the text is shown; `collapsibles` whether a folded section is supported; `checkboxes` whether a task-list item is drawn as a box; `dialect` the text format ('markdown' or 'plain'); `max_chars` the longest body, or null for no limit; `theme`: how a picture that has a light and a dark form is written ('picture' two sources in one element, 'suffix' two images told apart by an address suffix, 'single' only the light one). `unproven` names the capabilities of that row nobody has confirmed against the real surface: a composition that relies on one reports it, so it is checked before it is trusted. Composition reads these fields and never the surface's name. A new surface is a new row.
